newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seen floating silver mine on bourse soon.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seen floating silver mine on bourse soon.

text.p: Morocco is expected to float 20 percent of its minority stake in Imiter silver mine worth 650 million dirhams ($69 million) on the bourse soon, a Casablanca Finance Group stockbroker said on Monday.
"The flotation of Imiter firm on the stock exchange is imminent," the Casablanca-based stockbroker told Reuters.
It would be the first mining firm to be introduced on the bourse since the Moroccan government launched its ambitious privatisation programme in 1993, the stockbroker said.
The authorities plan to sell state stakes in 113 firms, including banks and sugar plants by end 1998, officials said.
Asked by Reuters, a privatisation ministry spokeswoman said a news conference will be held by the ministry officials on the Imiter issue on Tuesday afternoon.
She declined to give other details.

The state holds a stake of 33 percent of Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter (SMI) through the state-run Bureau des Recherches et Participations Minieres (BRPM), the remaining 67 percent of the capital is held by Morocco's largest private conglomerate, ONA group.
ONA's mining pole consolidated turnover rose 5.8 percent to 1.05 billion dirhams ($112 million) in 1996, the group said.
Last year it purchased four mines, including stakes in Imiter at more than 400 million dirhams, it added.
According to the privatisation ministry initial plan, BRPM would keep 10 percent stake of the silver mine and later sell it to ONA if an agreement was reached between the two parties, officials said.

One of the 10 profitable silver mines in the world with an estimated 1,000 grammes of silver per tonne of mineral products, Imiter has a life expectancy of up to eight years, Upline Securities stockbroker said.
The mine is located in the mountainous province of Ouarzazate, 500 kilometres south east of the Moroccan capital of Rabat.
Morocco's silver output is estimated at 200 tonnes per year, of which Imiter holds 88 percent of total production, Upline said.
